Observability._comment_ServiceName: traceId/spanId/service/level are the mandatory fields on every log entry (observability-standards.md); ServiceName is the 'service' field. kart-shipping-service is one of the four 100%-trace-coverage Order-Saga services (kart-conventions.md) - sampling ratio is left at the shared package's own default.

Otlp._comment_Endpoint: OpenTelemetry Collector OTLP/gRPC endpoint. Services never ship traces/logs to Tempo/Loki directly (observability-standards.md).

GlobalConfig._comment_Path: Absolute path to a JSON file, outside the repo and never committed, holding this environment's actual ConnectionStrings/RabbitMq credentials (PLATFORM_BLUEPRINT.md Configuration Management). Program.cs layers it on top of this file at startup and fails fast if the path is unset or missing. Local dev sets the concrete path in appsettings.Local.json; a deployed environment supplies it via the GlobalConfig__Path env var pointing at a mounted secret file.

ConnectionStrings._comment_ShippingDatabase: Secret - supplied via the GlobalConfig file, never committed.

Mongo._comment: The CQRS read side (contracts/README.md deviation #1). ConnectionString is a plain mongodb:// URI - swap it for a mongodb://mongos-router... sharded-cluster connection string in production with zero code change.

RabbitMq._comment: ManifestPath points at message-bus-manifest.json (copied here at build time from contracts/) - the single source of truth for this service's entire RabbitMQ topology. HostName is the only non-secret messaging setting not described by the manifest.
RabbitMq._comment_UserNamePassword: Secret - supplied via the GlobalConfig file, never committed. RabbitMQ's default 'guest' user only works over a literal loopback connection.

Carriers._comment_Priority: CarrierSelectionPolicy (ddd-model.md) - an externally-configured ordered priority list, primary then secondary on the primary's circuit tripping.

Identity._comment_JwksUri: kart-identity-service's public-key discovery endpoint, used to validate ops-principal access tokens (api-contract.yaml's opsPrincipal scheme).
